name: VLABench
description: VLABench is a large-scale benchmark designed to evaluate language-conditioned robotics manipulation tasks that require long-horizon reasoning. It features 100 task categories with randomized objects and assesses competencies such as world knowledge, common sense transfer, multi-step reasoning, and both action policy and language model capabilities.
reputation: A recent benchmark that is gaining attention in embodied AI and robotics for testing language-conditioned long-horizon manipulation, but it is not yet a widely established standard.
notes: Includes tasks requiring world knowledge, common sense transfer, and multi-step reasoning; provides high-quality training data; challenges current state-of-the-art VLAs and VLM-based workflows.
